hypothesis: M180 shows geometry offsets do not diversify the accepted wrong-history surface when the base first-action-distance threshold is 0.02. The next attempt should lower the action-distance filter and mine source-pair diversity directly before running expensive multi-variant sweeps.
success_criteria: start from M178 outcome rows and keep actor inputs unchanged
use min-base-action-distance 0.0 for a wider wrong-history candidate set
run a wrong-history-only boundary relocation first to reduce cost
pass a robustness gate with at least 10 strict physical pairs and 5 left steps
only if robustness passes, promote the surface to multi-variant replay or corpus construction
failure_criteria: continue blind lateral or longitudinal geometry sweeps after M180
build a training corpus from duplicate-dominated rows
run PPO before a robust source-diverse surface exists
change actor inputs or introduce hidden/oracle features
